name: Panera Artisan French Baguette (Side Bread Portion)
whyItWorks: Classic crusty white hearth bread made simply from enriched unbleached flour, water, yeast, and salt. Dairy-free, low-fat, low-residue, and ideal for dipping into clear broth.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Select the French Baguette as your complimentary side with any soup or sandwich (skip the apple or chips during active flares).
